app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $75, non-refundable.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants can get a fee waiver code by attending an NJIT international information session.
fee_waiver.quote: Attendees receive a code that waives the $75 application fee.

also.quote: You can receive a fee waiver code at an NJIT international information session.

gre_general.value: The GRE rule is set by each college, so see the program records for the college rule.

also.quote: Newark College of Engineering - GRE optional but strongly recommended for all MS and PhD applicants
Jordan Hu College of Science and Liberal Arts - GRE optional for all MS and PhD applicants
Ying Wu College of Computing - GRE optional but strongly recommended for all MS applicants; GRE required for all PhD applicants

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 on the previous scale (4.0 on the new scale).
toefl_min.quote: The minimum score required is 79 for the Internet-based TOEFL exam, 213 for the computer-based TOEFL exam, or 550 for the paper-based TOEFL exam.

also.quote: TOEFL iBT: 4.0 on the new scale, or 79 on the previous scale

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5, with no sub-score below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum score of 6.5 with no sub-score lower than 6.0 is required for the IELTS exam.

english_waiver.value: India is not on NJIT's list of countries whose degrees waive the test, and letters saying courses were taught in English are not accepted, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: NJIT does not accept medium of instruction (MOI) letters. A letter from your institution stating that courses were taught in English does not meet this requirement.

also.quote: A degree from an institution in one of the countries listed below
Countries Whose Degrees Qualify for a Waiver
